# Rollcage

> Safety checks for AI-assisted delivery on GitHub: PR risk scoring, coding-agent rules, secret scanning, vulnerability and policy gates, signed releases and DORA metrics.

To set Rollcage up in a repository, follow the agent instructions:

- [SETUP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frankTurtle/rollcage/main/SETUP.md): one command (`npx rollcage-init`), step by step, with rules for agents
- [docs/adopting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frankTurtle/rollcage/main/docs/adopting.md): the longer adoption path and checks
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frankTurtle/rollcage/main/README.md): what each piece does
